verdict.rationale: Mastra is a framework for building agents. The evidence shows Studio as an interface for building, testing and managing agents, and a scaffolding command that generates a general-purpose agent harness. Neither documents a built-in AI assistant inside the product that a user can delegate tasks to; these are developer building blocks and a management UI, so they are adjacent rather than direct support.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Run this command to create a general-purpose agent harness with a local workspace, shell tools, memory, task tracking, web access, and recurring schedules.
Studio is the interface for building, testing, and managing agents, workflows, and tools.
